description_en: Two-element (name and phone number) verification. Used to compare whether the name and phone number entered by the user belong to the same user
description_zh: 二要素（姓名和手机号）核验。用于比对用户填写的姓名、手机号两项信息是否属于同一用户
kebab_example: aliyun dytnsapi two-elements-verification --auth-code 'QASDW@#00' --input-number 13900000000 --mask MD5 --name '阿里云' --api-version 2020-02-17 --region cn-hangzhou
name: TwoElementsVerification

parameters.description_en:
The authorization code.

> On the **My Applications** page of the [Cell Phone Number Service console](https://dytns.console.aliyun.com/analysis/apply), obtain the authorization ID, which is the authorization code.
parameters.description_zh:
授权码。

> 在[号码百科控制台](https://dytns.console.aliyun.com/analysis/apply)**我的申请**页面，获取授权ID即授权码。

parameters.description_en:
The phone number to be verified.

- If Mask is set to NORMAL, this field is in plaintext.
- If Mask is set to MD5, encrypt this field with MD5.
- If Mask is set to SHA256, encrypt this field with SHA256.

><notice>Letters in the encrypted string are not case-sensitive.></notice>
parameters.description_zh:
待检验的号码。

- 若Mask取值为NORMAL，该字段为明文。
- 若Mask取值为MD5，请将该字段做MD5加密。
- 若Mask取值为SHA256，请将该字段做SHA256加密。

><notice>加密字符串中字母不区分大小写。></notice>
